_comment: Azure Workbook `{baseName}-ops` — operations/MONITORING.md §5. Import: Azure Monitor > Workbooks > New > Advanced editor > paste; set the Workspace parameter to {baseName}-logs. Every tile is bound to the two parameters: `{Workspace}` (resource picker) and `{TimeRange}` (substituted as `{TimeRange:seconds}s` inside the KQL, so one picker drives every section); the two trend tiles keep their declared 7 d / 30 d window and say so in the title, and the approval-SLA tiles never look back less than the 7 d window of the alert rule. Sections: Health, Quality, Oversight, Data protection, Delivery pipelines, Privileged access, Cost. Re-export here after each change (Low-risk change; LIFECYCLE.md V15). No hostnames, ids or secrets: the workspace is a parameter.

content.json:
# InfoSec Assurance Foundry — operations workbook `{baseName}-ops`

Source of record: `operations/MONITORING.md` §5 (sections) and `operations/kql/*.kql` (queries — the same text as the alert rules in `operations/alerts.bicep`). Read-only over the Log Analytics workspace `{baseName}-logs`; requires `Log Analytics Reader` (owner standing role, ledger L6; readers group L15). Controls: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.15, A.8.16; DORA Art. 10(1); EU AI Act Art. 26(5); ISO 42001 A.6.2.6.

Two parameters drive every section: **Workspace** (the Log Analytics workspace resource — `{baseName}-logs`) and **TimeRange**, substituted into each query as `{TimeRange:seconds}s`. Exceptions, stated in the tile titles: the verifier 7-day trend and the 30-day token chart keep their declared window, and the approval-SLA tiles never look back less than the 7 d window of the `approval-sla` alert rule, so a 1 h selection still shows every breached gate.

content.query:
let lookback = {TimeRange:seconds}s;
let p95LatencyBudgetMs = 300000;          // 5 min per run — reasoning-tier deliverables
let dailyTokenBudget   = 5000000;         // per agent per day; revisit monthly
let priceIn  = dynamic({"gpt-4o-mini": 0.15, "gpt-4o": 2.50, "o4-mini": 1.10, "o3-mini": 1.10});
let priceOut = dynamic({"gpt-4o-mini": 0.60, "gpt-4o": 10.00, "o4-mini": 4.40, "o3-mini": 4.40});
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where isnotempty(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]) or isnotempty(Properties["gen_ai.request.model"])
| extend agentName = coalesce(tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]), "(unattributed)"),
         model     = coalesce(tostring(Properties["gen_ai.request.model"]), "(unknown)"),
         inTok     = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         outTok    = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]),
         isRun     = Name has "process_thread_run" or Name has "invoke_agent" or Name has "create_run"
| summarize runs         = countif(isRun),
            p50Ms        = percentile(iff(isRun, DurationMs, real(null)), 50),
            p95Ms        = percentile(iff(isRun, DurationMs, real(null)), 95),
            inputTokens  = sum(inTok),
            outputTokens = sum(outTok)
          by agentName, model
| extend totalTokens = inputTokens + outputTokens
| extend estCostEur = round((todouble(inputTokens)  / 1000000.0) * todouble(priceIn[model])
                          + (todouble(outputTokens) / 1000000.0) * todouble(priceOut[model]), 2)
| extend breach = case(p95Ms > p95LatencyBudgetMs, "latency-p95",
                       totalTokens > dailyTokenBudget, "token-budget",
                       "")
| project agentName, model, runs, p50Ms = round(p50Ms, 0), p95Ms = round(p95Ms, 0),
          inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, estCostEur, breach
| order by totalTokens desc
content.title: Runs, p50/p95 latency and tokens per agent (latency-and-tokens.kql, full table)

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where AppRoleName has "fn-delivery"
| summarize requests = count(), failed = countif(Success == false), p95Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by Name
| extend successRate = round(1.0 - todouble(failed) / todouble(requests), 3)
| order by requests desc
content.title: Delivery Function requests: success rate and p95 (AppRequests)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where isnotempty(Properties["gen_ai.request.model"])
| extend model = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.request.model"])
| summarize calls = count(), throttled = countif(ResultCode == "429") by model
| extend throttledShare = round(todouble(throttled) / todouble(calls), 3)
content.title: 429 / throttling share per model (AppDependencies)

content.json: ## Quality — verifier and approvals (RUNBOOK M1; KPIS Q1)

content.query:
let lookback = {TimeRange:seconds}s;
let failRateThreshold = 0.30;
let minVerdicts = 5;
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where OperationName =~ "Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowActionCompleted"
| where ActionName in ("Notify_verifier_fail", "Human_approval_gate")
| summarize fails  = countif(ActionName == "Notify_verifier_fail"),
            passes = countif(ActionName == "Human_approval_gate"),
            lastFailRun = maxif(RunId, ActionName == "Notify_verifier_fail")
          by WorkflowName
| extend verdicts = fails + passes
| extend failRate = iff(verdicts > 0, todouble(fails) / todouble(verdicts), 0.0)
| project WorkflowName, verdicts, passes, fails, failRate = round(failRate, 2), lastFailRun
| order by failRate desc
content.title: Verifier PASS / FAIL per pipeline (verifier-fail-rate.kql, every pipeline)

content.query:
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where OperationName =~ "Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowActionCompleted"
| where ActionName in ("Notify_verifier_fail", "Human_approval_gate")
| summarize fails = countif(ActionName == "Notify_verifier_fail"), passes = countif(ActionName == "Human_approval_gate") by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), WorkflowName
| extend failRate = iff(fails + passes > 0, todouble(fails) / todouble(fails + passes), 0.0)
| project TimeGenerated, WorkflowName, failRate
content.title: Verifier FAIL rate 7-day trend (fixed 7 d window)

content.json: ## Oversight — human approval gates (HUMAN_APPROVAL.md Layer 3; KPIS R4, R6). Approvals per tier and the approver ≠ requester check come from the `{list:ApprovalDecisions}` export (team/approval-policy.json `record`), not from the workspace.

content.query:
let lookback = iff({TimeRange:seconds}s > 7d, {TimeRange:seconds}s, 7d);   // dashboard honours the picker but never below the alert window
let slaHours = 48;                     // 2 business days approximated; weekends reviewed manually
let gates = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ActionName == "Human_approval_gate" or ActionName startswith "Wait_for_approval_";
let started = gates
| where OperationName =~ "Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowActionStarted"
| project WorkflowName, RunId, ActionName, StartedAt = TimeGenerated;
let completed = gates
| where OperationName =~ "Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowActionCompleted"
| project RunId, ActionName, EndedAt = TimeGenerated, Status;
started
| join kind=leftouter completed on RunId, ActionName
| extend waitedHours = datetime_diff('hour', coalesce(EndedAt, now()), StartedAt)
| extend state = case(isempty(Status), "pending",
                      Status =~ "TimedOut", "expired",
                      Status =~ "Succeeded", "decided",
                      Status)
| where (state == "pending" and waitedHours > slaHours) or state == "expired"
| project WorkflowName, RunId, ActionName, StartedAt, state, waitedHours
| order by waitedHours desc
content.title: Pending gates beyond SLA and expired gates (approval-sla.kql)
Open gates with age (all, not only breached)

content.json: ## Data protection — egress detector and content filters (DATA_PROTECTION_GUARDRAILS.md §1; RUNBOOK FM-03). Expected: zero rows.

content.query:
let lookback = {TimeRange:seconds}s;
let internalMarkers = dynamic(["ENX-", "{internal-domain-suffix}", "{project-codename}", "{internal-ip-prefix}"]);
let assessmentIdRegex = @"\b(OT|TPA|IAF|INFOSEC)-\d{3,}\b";
let employeeNames = toscalar(datatable(name:string)["{name:watchlist-entry-1}", "{name:watchlist-entry-2}"] | summarize make_list(name));
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend toolName   = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"]),
         agentName  = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]),
         threadId   = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.thread.id"]),
         runId      = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.thread.run.id"]),
         toolInput  = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.call.arguments"]),
         eventText  = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.event.content"])
| where toolName has "bing" or Name has "bing" or Name has "web_search"
| extend query = coalesce(toolInput, eventText, Data)
| where isnotempty(query)
| extend hitMarker       = query has_any (internalMarkers),
         hitAssessmentId = query matches regex assessmentIdRegex,
         hitName         = query has_any (employeeNames)
| where hitMarker or hitAssessmentId or hitName
| project TimeGenerated, agentName, threadId, runId, toolName,
          querySample = substring(query, 0, 300),
          hitMarker, hitAssessmentId, hitName, OperationId, AppRoleName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Bing queries carrying internal markers (egress-detection.kql) — must be empty

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where isnotempty(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"])
| extend toolName = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"]), agentName = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(Success == false) by toolName, agentName
| order by calls desc
content.title: Tool calls per connection (AppDependencies by gen_ai.tool.name)

content.json: ## Delivery pipelines — failed and timed-out runs (RUNBOOK FM-19, FM-21; alert `pipeline-run-failed`). Same signal as `../infra/kql/pipeline-failures.kql` and the `kqlPipelineFailed` rule in `alerts.bicep`; the workbook drops the alert's fixed 1 h window for the `TimeRange` parameter. Expected: zero rows outside a known incident.

content.query:
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where OperationName =~ "Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowRunCompleted"
| where Status in ("Failed", "TimedOut", "Cancelled")
| project TimeGenerated, WorkflowName, RunId, Status, Error = column_ifexists("Error", "")
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Pipeline runs Failed / TimedOut / Cancelled (pipeline-failures.kql) — one row per run

content.query:
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where OperationName =~ "Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowRunCompleted"
| summarize runs = count(),
            succeeded = countif(Status == "Succeeded"),
            failed    = countif(Status in ("Failed", "TimedOut", "Cancelled")),
            lastRun   = max(TimeGenerated)
          by WorkflowName
| extend successRate = iff(runs > 0, round(todouble(succeeded) / todouble(runs), 3), 0.0)
| project WorkflowName, runs, succeeded, failed, successRate, lastRun
| order by failed desc, runs desc
content.title: Run outcome per pipeline: success rate and failure count

content.query:
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where OperationName =~ "Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowActionCompleted"
| where Status in ("Failed", "TimedOut")
| summarize failures = count(), lastFailure = max(TimeGenerated), runs = dcount(RunId) by WorkflowName, ActionName
| order by failures desc
content.title: Failing action per pipeline (where a run breaks: render, upload, gate, verifier)

content.json: ## Privileged access — ARM writes, PIM windows, Key Vault reads (TEAM_MODEL.md §12.3; BREAK_GLASS.md §4; RUNBOOK H7). Every write must reconcile with a PIM activation or the deploy service principal.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where ResourceGroup =~ "rg-infosec-foundry"
| where OperationNameValue endswith "/write" or OperationNameValue endswith "/delete" or OperationNameValue endswith "/action"
| where ActivityStatusValue in ("Success", "Succeeded")
| summarize writes = count(), operations = make_set(OperationNameValue, 20), lastWrite = max(TimeGenerated) by Caller
| order by writes desc
content.title: ARM writes in the resource group by caller (AzureActivity)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT" and OperationName == "SecretGet"
| where identity_claim_upn_s != ""
| summarize reads = count(), secrets = make_set(id_s, 20), lastRead = max(TimeGenerated) by upn = identity_claim_upn_s
| order by reads desc
content.title: Key Vault SecretGet by human identity (AzureDiagnostics) — expected only inside a PIM window

content.json: ## Cost — tokens and estimated EUR per agent and tier (TOKEN_ECONOMY_PLAYBOOK.md; RUNBOOK M2; KPIS E1a–c). Month-to-date vs forecast comes from Cost Management (budget `cost-budget.bicep`), not from the workspace.

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(Properties["gen_ai.request.model"])
| extend model = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.request.model"]), inTok = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), outTok = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize tokens = sum(inTok) + sum(outTok) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), model
content.title: Daily token volume per model, last 30 days (fixed 30 d window)
